summary.text: Ken Wells is a Republican state representative from Orleans-3 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ken Wells was born in Newport, Vermont, and earned a bachelor's degree from Lyndon State College.
His career experience includes working as a multimedia producer.
Wells assumed office in the Vermont House on January 8, 2025, succeeding David Templeman.
